question: Who among the following designed 7, Lok Kalyan Marg?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sir Edwin Lutyens**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Sir Edwin Lutyens was a renowned British architect who played a significant role in designing **New Delhi**, the new capital of India during British rule.
 
• He is famous for his distinctive architectural style that blends traditional motifs with classical elements, often referred to as "Lutyens' Delhi."
 
• **7, Lok Kalyan Marg** (previously known as 7, Race Course Road) is the official residence of the Prime Minister of India and was designed by Sir Edwin Lutyens.
 
• Lutyens' work in India includes several key government buildings and landmarks, including the India Gate and the Rashtrapati Bhavan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Le Corbusier**

 
 
• Le Corbusier was a Swiss-French architect, designer, and urban planner known for his contributions to modern architecture.
 
• He designed the city of Chandigarh in India, serving as the master planner and the architect of several key buildings.
 
• His architectural style emphasized functionality and simplicity, often using geometric forms and open spaces.
 
 
 
• **HK Mewada**
 
 
• HK Mewada was an Indian architect who worked closely with Le Corbusier on the Chandigarh project.
 
• He played a crucial role in implementing Le Corbusier's vision and design principles in the construction of Chandigarh.
 
 
 
• **Francois Martin**
 
 
• Francois Martin is not a widely recognized architect in the context of Indian architecture.
 
• He might be confused with other notable architects; however, he does not have a significant association with prominent Indian landmarks.
